summary: This plan keeps a simple record book for your tailoring shop in Kumasi. You can save each customer with their name, phone number and one set of measurements (chest, waist, hip and length, in inches), and change those measurements when they change. For each customer you can record orders: the garment, the date it is due, the price and the deposit paid, in cedis. You can see all of one customer's orders, look at a single order, and list every order due on or before a date you choose so you know what to finish first. When a customer picks up their clothes you mark the order as collected, and it then drops off that due list. You had no preference on two points, so I chose the simplest options. First, the deposit is entered once when the order is made and cannot be changed later. Second, an order can be marked as collected even if the customer still owes money. Questions for you: Would you like to be able to update the deposit when a customer pays more? Should only you be able to see customers' phone numbers and measurements (privacy)?
